title: Digital Pinball: Last Gladiators Ver.9.7
native_title: デジタル・ピンボール ラストグラディエーターズ Ｖｅｒ．９．７
overview:
An updated edition of the realistic pinball simulation Last Gladiators, with a slightly adjusted ball size and new ball physics. Play four themed tables: Gladiators, Knight of the Roses, Dragon Showdown and Warlock. Score by working the targets, lanes, ramps and bumpers, choose one of three bonus options before each ball, and clear each table's multiball and nine special bonus rounds to reach its Ultimate Round.

- Widened top center lane on the Knight of the Roses table
- The on-screen info arrow can be switched off in the options
- The pause menu shows the current table's reward and bonus values
- Includes a hidden demo of the Dreamlands table from Digital Pinball: Necronomicon
